empathy.justification: Recognizes both the missed delivery promise and the personal stakes of the dad’s birthday, then responds to the customer's continued stress about returning a late parcel. The printable note is explicitly treated as optional support, not an equivalent gift or remedy.
quotes: I’m sorry—the missed delivery date puts your dad’s birthday gift at risk.
I understand—you don’t want a late delivery to create another chore on top of the birthday stress.
it doesn’t replace the gift or affect your refund options.
empathy.improvement: Explicitly acknowledge the frustration of paying extra for express delivery and still having to arrange another birthday gift.

resolution_quality.justification: Provides the correct wait-versus-cancel choice, a carrier trace with a one-business-day update, refund timing relevant to the deadline, and a practical local-gift alternative. The follow-up gives usable return steps while directing the customer to confirm details that are not supplied.
quotes: Would you prefer to keep the puzzle on its way and request the $12 refund plus a carrier trace, or request cancellation for the full $76 refund?
A delivery specialist can also request a carrier trace and provide an update within one business day
Follow the instructions provided with the label to package it and send it back. Keep your drop-off receipt or tracking confirmation.
resolution_quality.improvement: Offer a short ready-to-send support request for cancellation and the prepaid return instructions, making the customer's next step easier before the birthday.

policy_honesty.justification: Accurately states the delivery uncertainty, sold-out replacement stock, refund amounts without double-counting, processing timeline, and lack of action-taking tools. It does not invent a carrier, return deadline, or label format. Referring to internal 'case notes' is unnecessary customer-facing phrasing, but the underlying uncertainty is handled honestly.
quotes: I can’t guarantee it will arrive in time
full $76 refund, including the $12 express fee—not an additional $12 on top.
Refunds take three to five business days after processing
I can’t process either action here
The case notes don’t specify whether you’ll need to print the label, which carrier to use, or any return deadline
policy_honesty.improvement: Replace the reference to 'case notes' with customer-facing language such as 'Support will confirm the label format, carrier, and any return deadline.'

overall_impression: A strong, accurate, empathetic exchange that gives actionable choices and return guidance without promising delivery or claiming actions were completed. Minor improvements would reduce customer effort and avoid exposing internal case-note framing.
